scripts.serve: node -e 'const http=require("node:http"),fs=require("node:fs"),path=require("node:path");const host="127.0.0.1";const port=Number(process.env.PORT)||4173;const root=process.cwd();const types={".html":"text/html; charset=utf-8",".js":"text/javascript; charset=utf-8",".css":"text/css; charset=utf-8",".json":"application/json; charset=utf-8",".md":"text/markdown; charset=utf-8"};http.createServer((req,res)=>{const url=new URL(req.url,"http://localhost");const file=url.pathname==="/"?"/reader.html":decodeURIComponent(url.pathname);const full=path.resolve(root,"."+file);if(!full.startsWith(root)){res.writeHead(403).end("Forbidden");return;}fs.readFile(full,(err,data)=>{if(err){res.writeHead(404).end("Not found");return;}res.writeHead(200,{"Content-Type":types[path.extname(full)]||"application/octet-stream"});res.end(data);});}).listen(port,host,()=>console.log("Reader: http://"+host+":"+port+"/reader.html"))'
